text:
Sofia Ramos: Heads-upPutting together a tiny pack of 'soundbyte' templates for OKR-aligned self-reviews and peer feedback. Goal: 3-line max per person managers can scan. Draft: https://notion.redwood/soundbytes (WIP)

Evan Li: Love it. Micro-self intro (3 bullets):
- Top contribution (1 line + metric)
- How I moved an OKR (1 line)
- Blocker + ask (1 line)
And 1-line peer prompts: Strength / Outcome / Growth.

Priya Nair: Add a 1-line calibration rubric for ratings:
- Exceeded: >1 measurable outcome or enabled team-level improvement.
- Met: Delivered expected scope reliably.
- Below: Missed commitments or recurring issues.
Keep it short.

Chris O'Neil: Manager quick-check (3 steps): Read self-review -> cite 2 examples -> add 1 growth action. If peers disagree, add a 1-line rationale. Use factual phrasing: "Observed: X. Impact: Y. Next: Z."

Evan Li: Also suggest a checkbox on form: "skip leadership prompts" for ICs. Makes it faster.

PeopleOps Bot: Resource uploaded: /handbooks/perf-cycle/soundbite-templates-v1.md 01768205200 (uploaded by Sofia Ramos).

Sofia Ramos: Thanks all. Pilot ask: volunteers for 2 teams to try this next week (collect ~10 reviews each). Evan + Chris volunteering. Action: finalize wording by 1768209000, run 4 business days, reconvene with samples. Will post final one-pager after pilot. :white_check_mark:
